measurement_note: Size S is the station count c, with c - 1 chain connections and 2c alternating outage/check queries. Each outage removes the current smallest station from the only component, forcing the next query to discover its successor. Tiers 16, 64, and 256 span 16x. Lazy heap deletion removes each station once; a correct component-rescan alternative must fail only scaling.
